name: Palo Signature Warm Amaretto Soufflé with Vanilla Bean Anglaise
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
whyItWorks: Offered alongside the Chocolate Soufflé: whipped egg-white and Disaronno Amaretto soufflé baked to order with zero cocoa fat, zero whole nuts, and zero citrus.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Even lighter than the Chocolate Soufflé because it has no cocoa butter; pair with a Lactaid pill for the warm vanilla bean sauce and gelato.
watchOuts: Dairy cream in vanilla bean anglaise and gelato
